item.text: The album rows currently retain discovered artwork file paths, while media file paths are available through the media file repository. I’ll add a directory accessor to albums, populate it from the artist’s media files during artwork lookup, and put the local `artist.*` check ahead of the existing image sources. The common source selector will also record elapsed time for every attempted source.

item.text:
Implemented local artist image lookup in the computed artist folder, with existing artwork sources as fallbacks. Album models now expose unique media directories, and artwork trace logs include the duration of each source attempt.

Added a regression test confirming that a local `artist.*` image is preferred. `go test ./core/artwork ./model` and `git diff --check` passed.
